parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit addresses all four error targets: it removes the factual error about authors easily identifying the ECG part, corrects the unsupported inference about RTLP vs. MARGE referencing methodology/results, separates specificity from grounding dimensions, and avoids stating a numeric score or gold label. The rationale preserves the correct observations about what each comment part requests while fixing the identified issues, and the change log clearly maps each correction to its target.
